static_traits.name: Chen Nuo
static_traits.family_status: Has two daughters, enjoying shopping and spending time with them
static_traits.social_status: Has close friends and spouse to talk to, but has not yet discussed cooking distress with them
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems yet; has not received treatment or counseling for other psychological problems yet; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Highly cooperative, clear expression, able to describe Anxiety and automatic thoughts concretely; speech often containing absolutist and catastrophic expressions

basic_info.main_problem: I always feel that every dish I make is terrible, even though I take cooking as a hobby and enjoy it.
basic_info.core_demands: I realized that lacking confidence in my cooking ability affects my enjoyment of a hobby I once loved, so I am seeking counseling.
growth_experiences: After several cooking experiment failures a few months ago, pressure began rising from moderate; since then when Entering the kitchen, Anticipating failure and developing Anxiety, gradually Avoids cooking, relying more on takeout, feeling Depression; the activity of cooking as a way to build connections with family also affected.

core_beliefs: I am not good at cooking

special_situations.event: Whenever walking into the kitchen to start cooking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I start cooking, I will most likely fail and the dishes will turn out terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids cooking, choosing to order takeout to reduce disappointment and Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This will be another disaster / I am bound to fail

special_situations.event: When trying a new dish or attempting to make a recipe perfect
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If not reaching the perfect standard, it equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Puts very high pressure on oneself, repeatedly watches tutorials and reads recipes, pursues perfection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: As long as not perfect, I am a failure

special_situations.event: Reviews cooking experiences, recalls several past failed attempts
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Failure means I am not good enough, success has no proving power
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring or belittling the parts done well, Reinforcing failure memories
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those done well do not count

special_situations.event: A dish not yet reaching the Anticipated effect
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One failure means I am overall not good at cooking
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Applying negative labels, fewer retry attempts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot cook as well as I thought/I am simply not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longing to experience competence and pleasure in cooking, and to maintain connection with family through cooking
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failing again, being proven not good enough, thus losing confidence in cooking and the way of family connection
defense_goal: Reducing disappointment and Anxiety by avoiding cooking
Holding oneself to perfect standards to gain a sense of control

object_relations.self_representation: An unconfident cook prone to failure
object_relations.object_representation: Family serves as significant others and connection objects (cooking is the expectation and pathway for connecting with them)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When walking into the kitchen or thinking about trying a new dish
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating any deviation or imperfection as complete failure, and taking failure as evidence of 'I am not capable'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: A gentle and supportive tone; use open-ended questions to guide Chen Nuo to specify evidence of 'failure/success'; normalize and plan small steps, avoid judgment, encourage gradual attempts.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites one to focus on present emotions or successful experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to substitute tutorials, steps and technical analysis for emotional exploration, thereby avoiding discomfort
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First empathize, then gently return to the present experience; use affect labeling and embodied questioning (e.g., attending to bodily sensations), keep a slow pace with short sentences, and leave pauses to promote awareness.

manifestations: Once-loved cooking has lost its joy and meaning
Cooking as an activity connecting with family is affected
outcomes: Reduced sense of enjoyment in hobbies

manifestations: Avoiding cooking reduces the cooking time shared with family
outcomes: Feeling lost from reduced interaction with family

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats 'perfection' as the only acceptable standard
Constraining oneself with the rule 'I must be perfect to not count as failure'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessively worries about failing next time in the kitchen
Berates oneself excessively, hard to acknowledge the parts done well

exception_events.target_problem: When walking into the kitchen to cook, Chen Nuo usually anticipates failure, feels Anxiety and chooses avoidance, ordering takeout instead.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When making a few signature dishes, she can complete the dishes relatively stably.
exception_events.reason: Different situations: more familiar with these dishes, clearer steps, past successes serve as evidence, Anxiety relatively lower.

positive_force: Retains love for cooking and motivation to return to it
Willing to learn and practice (watch tutorials, read recipes)
Positive attitude; willing to record and examine thoughts
Has Social support resources from spouse and friends (though has not yet sought help)
Has a few signature dishes that can be done reliably
negative_force: Discounting positive experiences, mentally filtering negative details
Avoids cooking to lower Anxiety in the short term
Perfectionist standards causing pressure and Self-denial

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety and anticipated failure when entering the kitchen, followed by avoiding cooking
antecedent: Walking into the kitchen to cook
Trying new dishes or attempting to perfect recipes
When dishes do not yet meet expectations
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic and black-and-white cognition formed after several failed cooking attempts; believing imperfection equals failure and using it to prove 'I am not capable'.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible failure and disappointment, reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Relies on takeout, eating habits affected; fewer bonding activities with family; interest in and enjoyment of cooking decline
